page_title: UDI 0-2 FIO | Udinese v Fiorentina 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' 0 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Marco Silvestri, so the score changes to 0:2.
90+1' Udinese couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
89' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
87' It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
87' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 10:2.
86' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
83' Andrea Sottil has decided to make a change. Simone Pafundi (Udinese) replaces Lazar Samardzic.
79' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) heads the ball towards the right post of the goal, but his attempt is denied by the goalkeeper.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is replacing Rolando Mandragora.
75' A substitution has been made. Hassane Kamara is replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
75' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Maxime Lopez is replaced by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Walace as he is replaced by Roberto Pereyra (Udinese).

71' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Pietro Terracciano makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
69' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
67' Isaac Success (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
65' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Christian Kouame and he is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
65' That will be all from Josip Brekalo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina).
65' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
63' Here is a change. Martin Payero is going off and Andrea Sottil gives the last tactical orders to Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
63' Today's match ends for Florian Thauvin who will be replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
61' The ball is cleared after Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Fiorentina force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Martin Payero (Udinese) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
57' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
56' A first-time shot by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
55' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
54' Martin Payero (Udinese) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
54' A lofted cross from Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
52' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' Martin Payero (Udinese) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Udinese get a corner.
51' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
50' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Martin Payero (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

47' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
46' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' A snap shot by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Pietro Terracciano produces a good save to thwart him.
45+3' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
45+1' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
44' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
42' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
41' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
39' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
36' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' Udinese are ruled offside.
32' 0 - 1 Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
30' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
28' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.

26' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
25' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
22' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Pietro Terracciano pulls off a great save to deny Florian Thauvin (Udinese), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
20' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
18' Martin Payero (Udinese) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
17' A player from Udinese takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Martin Payero (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
11' The free kick is taken by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina), but ball is cleared.
11' Referee Daniele Chiffi sees the trip by Nehuen Perez (Udinese) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
9' Good work from Udinese as they win a corner.
9' The resulting corner from Martin Payero (Udinese) is cleared by the defence.

8' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Vincenzo Italiano is forced to make a change. Dodo is unable to continue due to injury, Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) comes on.
5' Dodo (Fiorentina) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.

4' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
4' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Pietro Terracciano stops the ball from going into the top left corner.
3' Udinese are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
2' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
2' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
